preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 100 and 1 <= m <= 100 for n, m in [(int(stdin.split()[0]), int(stdin.split()[1]))])
preconditions.description: Input dimensions n and m are integers between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == m and all(abs(int(x)) <= 100 for x in line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the n lines contains exactly m integers, each with absolute value ≤ 100.

postconditions.expression: stdout.splitlines()[0].split() == ['a'] + [str(r) for r in row_spells] and len(row_spells) == int(a) and all(1 <= r <= n for r in row_spells) and len(set(row_spells)) == len(row_spells)
postconditions.description: First line contains an integer a (number of row spells) followed by distinct row indices (1-based) where the first spell is applied.

postconditions.expression: stdout.splitlines()[1].split() == ['b'] + [str(c) for c in col_spells] and len(col_spells) == int(b) and all(1 <= c <= m for c in col_spells) and len(set(col_spells)) == len(col_spells)
postconditions.description: Second line contains an integer b (number of column spells) followed by distinct column indices (1-based) where the second spell is applied.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(int(matrix[i-1][j-1]) * (-1 if i in row_spells else 1) * (-1 if j in col_spells else 1) for j in range(1, m+1)) >= 0 for i in range(1, n+1)) and all(sum(int(matrix[i-1][j-1]) * (-1 if i in row_spells else 1) * (-1 if j in col_spells else 1) for i in range(1, n+1)) >= 0 for j in range(1, m+1))
postconditions.description: After applying the specified row and column spells, every row sum and every column sum in the modified matrix is non-negative. Here, `matrix` is the parsed input grid (0-based), and `row_spells`/`col_spells` are the parsed 1-based indices from the output.
